brief.keyMessage: Shade for guests, sound so everyone hears the vows, a plan B for rain

body.value: An outdoor ceremony in full sun gets uncomfortable fast. Plan trees, a canopy or parasols so guests stay cool through the vows.
Wind, birds and open space swallow voices. A small speaker and a mic for the officiant and the couple keep every word clear.
Garden weather can turn in an hour. Hold a tent or an indoor space nearby and agree in advance when you will make the call.
